department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by March 1; applications are welcome until the term starts.
deadline.quote: March 1 (Students are encouraged to apply early but applications are welcome at any time prior to the start of the term.)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are highly encouraged to email faculty about supervision before applying.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students are highly encouraged to reach out to our faculty members via email for supervision opportunities.

funding.value: PhD students are offered a funding package (scholarships, TA, RA) on admission, and international PhD students get tuition support reducing fees to the domestic rate.
funding.quote: M.A.Sc. and Ph.D. students are offered a competitive funding package upon admission. | International Ph.D. students also receive an International Doctoral Tuition Support, reducing their tuition to the amount paid by domestic Ph.D. students in the same program.

entry_route.value: A thesis master's in civil engineering is normal; exceptional honours bachelor's graduates (A-) may be admitted directly with extra coursework.
entry_route.quote: the normal requirement for admission into the Ph.D. program is a master's degree with a thesis in civil engineering | exceptional applicants holding an honours bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering with an average of A- or better

notes: Environmental Engineering is a separate PhD in the same department (deadline March 1, via OCIENE); Building Engineering also has its own PhD.
